steps.until: (() => { const r = tre.activeVillage.state().entities.find((e) => e.id === 'raid')?.raid; if (!r) return null; const at = r.enemies.filter((e) => (e.state === 'walk' || e.state === 'wait') && !e.aside).map((e) => (e.x - r.wall.x) * r.dir.x + (e.z - r.wall.z) * r.dir.z).filter((d) => r.posts.some((q) => Math.abs(q.d - d) <= 1)).sort((a, b) => a - b)[0]; return at === undefined ? null : r.posts.reduce((a, q) => (Math.abs(q.d - at) < Math.abs(a.d - at) ? q : a)).d; })() !== null
